channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Wearable ultrasound patch enhances REM sleep without drugs
item.description: A wearable patch helped 28 participants reach and maintain REM sleep longer, offering a non-invasive alternative to medication or surgery.

item.title: Ancient microbes discovered on 5,300-year-old Iceman
item.description: Researchers found a diverse array of ancient and modern microorganisms on Otzi the Iceman, offering new insights into his preserved body.

item.title: Earth's molten core suddenly reversed direction, puzzling scientists
item.description: Earth's molten iron core unexpectedly reversed direction beneath the Pacific, revealing a dramatic change in the planet's internal engine.

item.title: Scientists rediscover lost Megalodon fossils, revealing a 79-foot giant
item.description: Several enormous Megalodon vertebrae thought destroyed in 1989 were found on a museum shelf, strengthening estimates of the shark's size.
